Aquatic Viper Vine.name: Aquatic Viper Vine
Aquatic Viper Vine.description:
A voracious, flesh-eating carnivore, the viper vine has a single enormous blossom arising from a thick, leafy tangle of snakelike vines. When the plant senses the approach of suitable prey through its sensitive, shallow-buried root system, it rises up like an agitated snake and unfurls its brightly colored bloom, an act that releases a cloud of mind-numbing pollen.

Since viper vines gain nourishment by consuming creatures rather than through photosynthesis and absorbing nutrients from the soil, they have developed rudimentary locomotion and can drag themselves along the ground with tentacle-like roots. They even have a form of rudimentary sentience, allowing them to both discern differences in prey and make limited tactical decisions, while also avoiding creatures that are particularly large or dangerous looking.

The area around viper vine hunting grounds is often strewn with the partially devoured remains of victims. It's not unusual to find the rotting corpses of wild animals, ill-fated adventurers, and even giants in the plant's immediate vicinity, along with a scattering of incidental treasure left behind on the corpses. A viper vine rarely returns to the carcass of a creature it killed earlier, preferring to hunt fresh meat.

Эффект: The Bellflower chant swells from the assembled crowd. All grabbed, restrained, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe] creatures can attempt to Escape as a free action. The Bellflower chant then rolls initiative.

Brimstone Corps.name: Brimstone Corps
Brimstone Corps.description: Солдаты, участвующие в многочисленных военных кампаниях, приобретают опыт, необходимый для того, чтобы стать лучшими в своей армии. Пехотинцы первого класса несут службу на полях сражений, где победа имеет первостепенное значение.

items.name: Hell's Call
items.description: The Brimstone Corps have pledged their souls to Hell and welcome its embrace. The troop doesn't attempt a rout check when it's reduced from one HP threshold to another. When reduced to 2 segments, the troop gains a +2 circumstance bonus to attack and damage rolls as the last surviving troop members sell their lives dearly before they're called to Hell.

items.name: Ни шагу назад
items.description: These soldiers have been extensively trained to hold their ground no matter the situation. If any effect would force the brimstone corps to move, reduce the distance by 10 feet. Any time they would be affected by the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D] condition, the brimstone corps is instead @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 2} for the same duration.

items.name: Защита отряда
items.description:
ОЗ: 240 (4 сегмента); Пороги: 160 (3 сегмента), 80 (2 сегмента)

@Localize[PF2E.NPC.Abilities.Glossary.TroopDefenses]

items.name: Залп болтов
items.description: The brimstone corps draws, loads, and shoots a salvo from their crossbows. The salvo is a @Template[type:burst|distance:10] within 120 feet that deals @Damage[4d8[piercing]|options:area-damage] damage (@Check[reflex|dc:30|basic|options:area-effect] save). When the brimstone corps is reduced to 2 segments, this area decreases to a @Template[type:burst|distance:5].

items.name: Лязг стали
items.description:
от @Glyph[Action 1] до @Glyph[Action 3]

Частота: Раз в раунд

Эффект: The brimstone corps attacks each enemy in a @Template[type:emanation|distance:5], with a @Check[reflex|dc:29|basic|options:area-effect] save. The damage depends on the number of actions.

@Glyph[Action 1] @Damage[(2d6+1)[slashing]|options:area-damage]

@Glyph[Action 2] @Damage[(4d6+10)[slashing]|options:area-damage]

@Glyph[Action 3] @Damage[(4d6+18)[slashing]|options:area-damage]

items.name: Обучены построениям
items.description:
Частота: Раз в раунд

Эффект: The brimstone corps uses @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-ability-glossary-srd.Item.USyDPcSdzcm024zT]. A brimstone corps unit typically knows the marching column and wedge formations.

items.name: Первоклассная атака
items.description: The brimstone corps rushes forward with a hunger for battle. They Stride up to twice their Speed. At the end of their movement, each enemy within a @Template[type:emanation|distance:5] takes @Damage[(2d6+5)[slashing]|options:area-damage] damage, with a @Check[reflex|dc:30|basic|options:area-effect] save.

Captivating Gem.name: Captivating Gem
Captivating Gem.descriptionHazard: The floating gem flares with inner radiance, sending out beams of light to captivate and drain the vitality from all who approach.
Captivating Gem.disable: @Check[arcana|dc:35] (expert), @Check[occultism|dc:35] (expert), or @Check[religion|dc:35] (expert) to unravel the magical matrix within the gem, @Check[crafting|dc:40] or @Check[thievery|dc:40] check to unbalance the crystal's alignment, or a @Check[athletics|dc:43] check to damage one of the gem's facets and change its geometry; two successes are required to disable the hazard
Captivating Gem.routine: (3 actions) The captivating gem attempts uses all three of its actions to incapacitate creatures. It targets the closest creature with its Freezing Light ability, then a different creature with its facet flare Strike. If a creature has already been @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6uEgoh53GbXuHpTF] by Freezing Light, it chooses a different target for that ability.

items.name: Freezing Light
items.description:
The captivating gem shines intense light on a living creature, freezing it in place. The target must attempt a @Check[fortitude|dc:40] Save.

Критический успех: Цель невредима.

Успех: The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1} and takes @Damage[2d12[force]] damage.

Провал: The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6uEgoh53GbXuHpTF] for 1 round and takes @Damage[4d12[force]] damage.

Критический провал: The target is paralyzed for 1 round and takes @Damage[8d12[force]] damage.

items.name: Glint
items.description:
Триггер: Any living creature approaches within 10 feet of the gem

Эффект: The captivating gem targets the triggering creature with a facet flare Strike and then rolls initiative.

items.name: Facet Flare
items.description: The target must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|dc:40] save or become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 1}

Cathilia's Meddling.name: Cathilia's Meddling
Cathilia's Meddling.descriptionHazard: A Hellknight on horseback shouts commands, beseeching all to return to order.
Cathilia's Meddling.disable: @Check[Hellknight Lore|dc:21] (trained) to convince the Hellknight that she's adding to chaos, or @Check[diplomacy|dc:25] to request she stop yelling
Cathilia's Meddling.routine: (3 actions) Cathilia uses her Hellknight's Orders Strike on creatures engaged in open fighting in area A2. She randomly chooses between targets in the likely case that there are multiple combatants.

items.name: Stop, Burglar
items.description:
Триггер: A creature other than Zefiro opens the Museum's gates

Эффект: Cathilia shouts at the triggering creature. The target must succeed at a @Check[will|dc:27] save or have their action disrupted, and then Cathilia's meddling rolls initiative.

Champion of Asmodeus.name: Champion of Asmodeus
Champion of Asmodeus.description:
The deific champion is the paragon of champions, representing the truest form of devotion and dedication to a deity.

Религии вдохновляют верующих следовать их принципам.

items.name: Арбалет
items.description: Это дальнобойное оружие имеет механизм, похожий на лук, установленный на раме с ручкой, называемой ложе. Ложе имеет механизм фиксации тетивы, прикрепленный к спусковому крючку, который высвобождает тетиву и запускает болт.

items.name: Длинный меч
items.description: Длинные мечи, также известные как романские мечи, могут иметь одностороннюю или двустороннюю заточку. Их клинки тяжёлые и имеют длину от 3 до 4 футов.

items.name: Стальной щит
items.description:
Как и деревянные щиты, стальные изготавливаются разных форм и размеров. Хоть и дороже деревянных щитов, но они гораздо более прочные.

ТвёрдостьОЗПП
52010

items.name: Полный латный доспех
items.description: Пластинчатая доспех состоит из сцепленных пластин, которые заключают почти все тело в стальной панцирь. Он дорогостоящий и тяжелый, и владельцу часто требуется помощь, чтобы надеть его правильно, но он предоставляет одну из лучших защит, что может дать доспех. Комплект этого доспеха поставляется вместе с надеваемым под низ @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.zBYEU9E7034ENCmh]{Стёганым доспехом} и парой @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.Ix2vicchE79d6Cl3]{Латных рукавиц}.

items.name: Религиозный символ Асмодея
items.description: Этот кусок дерева или серебра гравирован изображением, представляющим божество. Некоторые сакральные заклинатели, такие как жрецы, могут использовать религиозный символ своего божества как сакральный фокус при использовании некоторых умений и сотворении некоторых заклинаний. Чтобы использовать религиозный символ, его надо держать в одной руке.

items.name: Зелье полёта
items.description:
Активация: @Glyph[Action 1] (@Trait[Manipulate]{воздействие})

Выпив это шипучее зелье, вы на 1 минуту получаете Скорость полёта 40 футов.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-effects.Item.Mf9EBLhYmZerf0nS]

items.name: Клык гадюки
items.description:
Активация: @Glyph[Reaction] (@Trait[Concentrate]{концентрация})

Триггер: Существо в досягаемости использует действие с признаком @Trait[Manipulate]{воздействие} или @Trait[Move]{движение}, делает дистанционную атаку, или покидает квадрат во время используемого им @Trait[Move]{движения}

Требования: Вы мастер обращения с оружием, к которому прикреплён талисман

Когда вы активируете этот укрепленный смолой череп гадюки, совершите "Удар" ближнего боя по спровоцировавшему существу. Если у вас есть @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.KAVf7AmRnbCAHrkT]{Реагирующий удар}, то можете активировать клык гадюки свободным действием (@Glyph[Free]). Если ваша атака является критическим попаданием, и спровоцировавшее действие имело признак @Trait[Manipulate]{воздействие}, то вы прерываете это действие. Штраф множественных атак не применяется к этому "Удару", а сам он не учитывается при подсчёте вашего штрафа множественных атак.

Если вы попадаете этой атакой, существо подвергается воздействию яда клыка гадюки.

Яд клыка гадюки: (@Trait[Poison]{яд})

Спасбросок: @Check[fortitude|dc:32]

Макс.продолжительность: 4 раунда

Стадия 1: @Damage[3d10[poison]] и @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Ослаблен 1} (1 раунд)

items.name: Болты
items.description: Короче традиционных стрел, но похожи по конструкции, болты являются амуницией для арбалетов.

items.name: Благословенный щит
items.description: In the deific champion's hands, a shield gains the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.bvROhtzAez0KP7Vt]{moderate reinforcing rune}, giving it Hardness 8, 84 HP, and BT 42.

items.name: Deific Reactions
items.description: At the start of each of their turns, the deific champion gains an additional reaction they can only use to make a Reactive Strike or to Shield Block.

items.name: Аура чемпиона
items.description:
15 feet.

Any follower of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.deities.Item.QRkcFciCOmFoxF1B] in the aura knows the champion is a champion of Asmodeus. Enemies in the champion's aura take a –1 circumstance penalty to saving throws against fear. In addition, an enemy that ends its turn in the champion's aura can't reduce the value of its frightened condition below 1.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-effects.Item.aVxksct3yToQUFAC]

items.name: Champion's Courage
items.description: When the champion becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL], they reduce the condition value by 1 (to a minimum of 0).

items.name: Exalted Retributive Strike
items.description:
Триггер: An enemy damages the deific champion's ally, and both are in the deific champion's aura

Эффект: The ally gains resistance 14 to all damage against the triggering damage. If the enemy is within reach, the deific champion makes a melee Strike against it. Each ally in the champion's aura can spend a reaction to Strike the target with a –5 penalty.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-effects.Item.KzwcLwJ4c6hon0pu]

items.name: Will Not Fall
items.description:
Триггер: The deific champion's Hit Points are reduced to 0 for the first time that day

Эффект: The champion presses on, refusing to fail their god. They remain standing with 25 Hit Points.

items.name: Клык гадюки
items.description:
Триггер: Существо в досягаемости использует действие с признаком @Trait[Manipulate]{воздействие} или @Trait[Move]{движение}, делает дистанционную атаку, или покидает квадрат во время используемого им @Trait[Move]{движения}

Требования: Вы мастер обращения с оружием, к которому прикреплён талисман

When you activate this resin-strengthened viper skull, make a melee Strike against the triggering creature.

If you have Reactive Strike, you can activate the viper's fang as a free action.

If your attack is a critical hit and the trigger was a manipulate action, you disrupt that action.

This Strike doesn't count toward your multiple attack penalty, and your multiple attack penalty doesn't apply to this Strike.

If you hit with this attack, the creature is exposed to viper fang venom.

Яд клыка гадюки: (@Trait[Poison]{яд})

Спасбросок: @Check[fortitude|dc:32]

Макс.продолжительность: 4 раунда

Стадия 1: @Damage[3d10[poison]] и @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Ослаблен 1} (1 раунд)

items.name: Will Not Falter
items.description:
Эффект: The deific champion declares their devotion to their deity and their cause. They Stride, then make a melee Strike. If the Strike hits an enemy, all allies within their champion's aura gain a +2 status bonus to attack rolls and saving throws against fear until the start of the deific champion's next turn.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-effects.Item.N402OXwxrqVkcK87]

Collapsing Egorian Building.name: Collapsing Egorian Building
Collapsing Egorian Building.descriptionHazard: Tremors from the changing landscape could cause a building to collapse.
Collapsing Egorian Building.disable: @Check[athletics|dc:45] (master), @Check[crafting|dc:45] (master), or @Check[engineering-lore|dc:45] (master) to brace the structure against collapse until the end of the creature's next turn. The DC of the flat check for this round (see Routine) decreases by 4 on a success (or by 8 on a critical success). Decreasing the flat check DC to 0 stabilizes the structure, ending this hazard.
Collapsing Egorian Building.reset: The building becomes susceptible to Shake to Pieces again [[/gmr 1d4 #rounds]]{1d4 rounds} after it's stabilized.
Collapsing Egorian Building.routine: (1 action) The GM rolls a @Check[flat|dc:11], decreasing the DC as noted above. If the check fails, dust and debris fall within the building and 30 feet around it, providing concealment for 1 round and dealing @Damage[10d6[bludgeoning]] damage to 1d4 randomly chosen targets in the area (@Check[reflex|dc:40|basic] save); a target that critically fails this save is also knocked @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]. If the flat check critically fails, the effect is the same, but damage from the debris increases to 16d6, it affects 2d4 randomly chosen targets, and a creature that critically fails its save is knocked prone and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM] by the rubble ([[/act escape dc=40]], [[/act force-open dc=44]]).
Collapsing Egorian Building.stealth: (expert) to notice cracks forming in the walls of the structure

items.name: Shake to Pieces
items.description:
Триггер: The Hellfire tornado moves adjacent to the building

Эффект: Строение содрогается. Пол здания и улицы в радиусе 30 футов от него становятся @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.S55aqwWIzpQRFhcq.JournalEntryPage.z68vgV2XWhi1KYEP#mestnostь]{Сложной местностью}; существа на этой сложной местности получают штраф обстоятельства −2 к своим броскам атаки, КБ и проверкам навыков. После этого опасность совершает бросок инициативы.

Crowncrusher Bulwark.name: Crowncrusher Bulwark
Crowncrusher Bulwark.description: Stone bulwarks are slow and steady constructs typically carved from marble or granite. They're often made to serve as works of art when at rest, so some magical crafters employ master sculptors to ensure their constructs make beautiful statues. Older stone bulwarks might be weathered, with scuffed or cracked surfaces or missing noses and digits, but this weathering is largely cosmetic and doesn't adversely impact the bulwark's functionality.

items.name: Statuary Aura
items.description:
20 feet.

Rocks of marble magically arise from the ground in the aura. They protect the bulwark's allies, giving each of them standard @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.other-effects.Item.I9lfZUiCwMiGogVi]{Cover}. These stones can be used for Throw Rock.

This aura automatically activates at the start of the stone bulwark's first turn in combat and deactivates at the end of combat.

items.name: Binding Stone
items.description: Any creature hit by the stone bulwark's fist or rock Strike is affected by a @Check[fortitude|dc:30] @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.gPvtmKMRpg9I9D7H] spell.

items.name: Неумолимое шествие
items.description: The stone bulwark Strides up to its Speed, pushing back each creature whose space it moves into and damaging them if they try to stop its movement. A creature can attempt to bar the way by succeeding at a @Check[fortitude|dc:34] save. On a critical success, the resisting creature takes no damage; otherwise it is damaged as if hit by the construct's fist.

Crowncrusher Riot.name: Crowncrusher Riot
Crowncrusher Riot.descriptionHazard: A crew of anarchists rush to fight the dottari.
Crowncrusher Riot.disable: @Check[intimidation|dc:21] to force them to back down, or @Check[diplomacy|dc:25] (expert) to request that they only injure the dottari
Crowncrusher Riot.routine: (2 actions) The rioters lob bricks and other heavy objects at any dottari excruciator divisions as an action, dealing @Damage[(2d6+10)[bludgeoning]] damage to the dottari and any adjacent creatures (@Check[reflex|dc:27|basic] save).

items.name: While They're Distracted
items.description:
Триггер: A dottari excruciator division deals damage to a living creature

Эффект: The Crowncrusher riot throws a volley of homemade explosives that deals @Damage[2d10[fire]] damage to the triggering creature and all creatures within 10 feet of it (@Check[reflex|dc:27|basic] save), and then rolls initiative.

items.name: Языки
items.description: Common

items.name: Трезубец
items.description: Это трехконечное копьеобразное оружие обычно имеет 4-футовое древко. Как и копьём, им можно владеть одной рукой или метать.

items.name: Alleviation Vulnerability
items.description: Whenever an effect restores at least one foe within 30 feet of the cultist to the target's full Hit Points, the cultist takes @Damage[2d8[mental]] damage.

items.name: Amplify Torment
items.description: The cultist's Strikes deal an additional @Damage[1d8[mental]] damage to creatures that are injured. This additional damage increases to @Damage[1d12[mental]] if the target has fewer than half its HP remaining.

items.name: Булава
items.description: С крепкой рукоятью и тяжёлым металлическим навершием, булава прочна и позволяет её владельцу наносить мощные удары и пробивать доспехи.

items.name: Прочный щит [Сильный]
items.description:
Благодаря превосходной конструкции и отличному мастерству ремесленника, этот стальной щит имеет более высокую Твердость, чем его немагические аналоги, из-за чего его сложнее поломать и разрушить.

Твердость 17, ОЗ 136, ПП 68.

items.name: Латный доспех Адских Рыцарей
items.description:
Hellknights wear a variety of armors decorated with designs specific to the order. Hellknight half plate is the armor of choice for Hellknight signifiers, and Hellknight breastplate serves those in the order who lack the training to wear heavy armor.

A character who is a member of the Hellknights has access to these uncommon armors.

items.name: Восстановление
items.description:
Когда могильный рыцарь уничтожен, его доспехи восстанавливают его тело в течение [[/gmr 1d10 #дни]]{1d10 дней}, или быстрее, если доспехи надеты на живого носителя. Если тело будет уничтожено до этого, процесс начнется заново.

Могильного рыцаря можно уничтожить навсегда, только уничтожив его доспехи (например с помощью @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.r7ihOgKv19eJQnik]), переместив его в Кузницу Созидания или бросив в сердце вулкана.

items.name: Святотатственная аура
items.description:
30 feet.

When a creature in the aura uses a vitality spell or ability, the graveknight automatically attempts to counteract it, with a counteract modifier of [[/r 1d20+0 #Counteract]]{+34}.

items.name: Разрушительный взрыв
items.description:
The graveknight unleashes a @Template[cone|distance:30] of energy. Creatures in the area take @Damage[21d6[mental]] with a @Check[will|dc:40|basic|options:area-effect] save.

The graveknight can use this ability once every [[/gmr 1d4 #Recharge Devastating Blast]] rounds.

items.name: Проклятие могильного рыцаря
items.description:
Это проклятие действует на всех, кто носит доспехи могильного рыцаря не менее 1 часа.

Спасбросок: @Check[will|dc:42] save

Возникновение: 1 час

Стадия 1: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.3uh1r86TzbQvosxv]{Обречен 1} и не может снять доспех (1 день)

Стадия 2: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.3uh1r86TzbQvosxv]{Обречен 2}, штраф −10 футов к Скоростям и не может снять доспех (1 день)

Стадия 3: умирает и превращается в могильного рыцаря этих доспехов.

items.name: Фантомный скакун
items.description:
HP 125; AC 40, Fort +32, Ref +27, Will +29

The graveknight summons a supernatural mount, as @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.WPKJOhEihhcIm2uQ] heightened to a rank equal to half the graveknight's level. Unlike marvelous mount, the steed's AC and saving throw bonuses are all 4 lower than the graveknight's, and the steed has one-third the graveknight's Hit Points (rounded down).

If the steed is destroyed, the graveknight must wait 1 hour before using this ability again.

items.name: Разрушительное оружие
items.description: Any weapon the graveknight wields or unarmed attack the graveknight uses gains the effects of the greater fearsome weapon rune, deals an additional 1d6 mental damage, and functions as a +1 striking weapon rune.

items.name: Мастер оружия
items.description: Могильный рыцарь получает доступ к критическим специализациям любого оружия, которым он владеет.

Deadly Spinning Blade Pillar.name: Deadly Spinning Blade Pillar
Deadly Spinning Blade Pillar.descriptionHazard: A spinning metal pole covered in deadly blades is hidden in the ceiling, connected to several trigger plates around the room and a hidden control panel built into the bed frame.
Deadly Spinning Blade Pillar.disable: @Check[thievery|dc:39] (master) three times on a pillar, or @Check[thievery|dc:37] (master) twice on the control panel deactivates the whole trap. Breaking the control panel prevents anyone from disabling the trap using the control panel and prevents the trap from deactivating automatically (see Reset below)
Deadly Spinning Blade Pillar.routine: (3 actions) The trap uses its first action to make a spinning blade Strike against each adjacent creature. Dottari Excruciator Division.name: Dottari Excruciator Division
Dottari Excruciator Division.description:
The dottari serve as Cheliax's elite city guards, assembled and deployed to quash serious threats. Queen Abrogail Thrune I founded the original excruciator divisions to restore order to a nation torn by civil war and not yet fully submissive to Thrune rule. To this day, the dottari are empowered to destroy property (or break a few bones) in carrying out their duties.

Dottari are trained to neutralize foes nonlethally, but they empowered to use lethal force at their discretion (and often do). They're also famed for their alchemical crossbow bolts—many tipped with fast-acting, explosive glue—ending altercations before they've really begun.

Elder Sweet Hag.name: Elder Sweet Hag
Elder Sweet Hag.description:
Sweet hags use bright colors, pleasant visages, and sugary treats to draw in children and the young at heart. Their favorite prey is impoverished youngsters who are unlikely to be missed—sweet hags offer them food and a veneer of kindness before devouring the hapless child. Sweet hags also enchant their food to magically charm others, often using these bespelled servitors to handle all of their busywork. Though they present a lovely and generous face to the world, they turn vicious when insulted or defied. A sweet hag's true form is a dribbling mass of flesh with gumdrop eyes, often resembling melting taffy.

Hags are malevolent predators who use magic and manipulation to lure children and young adults into their clutches. Though their true forms are eldritch and horrifying, hags spend much of their lives disguised as ordinary women. They seek out targets who are unhappy, innocent, or otherwise vulnerable, preying on their weaknesses before snatching them up. The typical hag is abusive, controlling, and narcissistic. Though less malicious hags possibly exist, they rarely reveal their true forms, making them nearly impossible to find.

Gorthoklek.name: Gorthoklek
Gorthoklek.description:
When an army of devils invades to bathe a region in bloodshed and hellfire, it is likely that one of the nessaris masterminded the incursion. Cunning, powerful, and ruthless, nessaris often serve the archdevils directly. They rule infernal duchies, subjugate mortal worlds, and usurp infernal rivals using unparalleled despotism and calculated ferocity. To realize their tyrannical machinations, nessaris claim mortal souls that they corrupt into ort servants, which can then be shaped and transformed through infernal manipulation into the terrifying devils that form Hell's formidable legions. They often select the most wicked and vicious orts for their armies, drawing upon these lesser devils' depravity during powerful magical ceremonies to create hideous and terrifying abominations that can cow and eviscerate the nessari's enemies.

Each nessari is crafted deep within the nightmarish bowels of Nessus, the ninth layer of Hell, to serve the whims of archdevils and infernal dukes. Those nessaris that don't leave Nessus to command infernal legions in the upper layers of Hell often form the courts of Hell's elite, gathering cronies and sects that shape Hell's political landscape through subterfuge and manipulation. But many nessaris see themselves as living embodiments of hellfire, the all-encompassing wrath of Hell, and thus prefer to dwell in realms consumed by fire. In Avernus, Dis, Malebolge, Nessus, and Phlegethon, nessaris build vast citadels of brimstone wreathed in flame to lord over.

Rather than being above the constant power struggles of the diabolic ranks, nessaris are in the thick of it. Even apocalyptic schemes to conquer or despoil mortal worlds usually begin from a desire to claw a single rank up the immortal hierarchy of Hell. For this reason, the best, yet also most dangerous, ally against a nessari is the nessari next to them.

Nessaris tower over other devils, standing at least 16 feet tall, weighing over 1,000 pounds, and brandishing wingspans in excess of 20 feet.

Infernal Dukes

Elite members of Hell's political infrastructure and leadership hierarchy, the dukes of Hell are chosen from among the most tyrannical, oppressive, and conniving devils. While not all infernal dukes are nessaris, a nessari's natural disposition toward conquest and oppression often makes them an ideal candidate for this position. To create an infernal duke, adjust the nessari to be between 21st and 25th level. Because of their physical prowess, manipulative nature, and powerful spellcasting abilities, infernal dukes make excellent villains for long-running campaigns.

Masters of corruption and architects of conquest, devils seek both to tempt mortal life to join in their pursuit of all things profane and to spread tyranny throughout all worlds. The temptations they offer mortals range from great powers granted by the signing of an infernal contract to twisted favors following a whispered pledge to a diabolic patron, or any number of even subtler exchanges. Those who succumb to these temptations find themselves consigned to an afterlife of endless torment in the pits of Hell, wherein the only hope of escape lies in the chance of being promoted to become a devil in the infernal ranks.

Every devil has a specific role to play in the upkeep of the remorseless bureaucratic machine that is Hell, from soldiers and scholars to inquisitors, lawyers, judges, and executioners. Lowly orts perform subservient labor to more powerful and specialized devils, such as infantry and contract devils, while the greatest nessaris command entire infernal armies.

Asmodeus stands at the apex of the structure he created, but the layers below him are marked by a constant jockeying for position. Most diabolic plans ultimately serve to improve the schemer's place in the hierarchy.

Greater Hellcat.description:
Адские кошки — коварные хищники, обитающие в огненных ямах Ада. Хотя эти чудовищные создания выглядят как скелетные смилодоны, их кости дымятся от жара и капает кипящая кровь, они не являются нежитью. Это живые порождения Ада с прозрачной плотью, сквозь которую видны их горящие скелеты. Типичная адская кошка достигает @Unit[Foot|9]{9 футов} в длину и весит @Unit[Pound|1000]{1 000 фунтов}.

Предоставленные сами себе, адские кошки проводят время на охоте — то есть ищут и преследуют добычу, получая удовольствие от погони. Будучи чудовищными созданиями, они не нуждаются в смертной пище, но пожирают добычу ради удовольствия причинять боль. Они также гораздо умнее, чем многие думают, и обижаются, когда с ними обращаются как с неразумными животными. Тот, кто относится к адской кошке как к единице, может стать трофеем для её стаи, ведь адская кошка прикладывает все усилия, чтобы скоординировать продуманную месть тем, кто не проявляет должного уважения.

Хотя они не умеют говорить, адские кошки знают инфернальный язык и могут общаться с помощью телепатии с любым существом, способным говорить. Они редко говорят, разве что угрожают шепотом и подтверждают приказы своих дьявольских хозяев.

Адские кошки быстро отступают, если их явно превосходят в силах или если им противостоят враги, до которых они не могут добраться, но они никогда не забывают о добыче, которая ускользает от них.

The creature that dealt the triggering Strike must succeed at a @Check[will|dc:37] save or become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2} (@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 4} on a critical failure).

items.description: The greater hellcat telepathically links its senses to all other hellcats within 100 feet for 10 minutes. It loses this contact with any hellcat that moves out of a 100-foot radius. While linked to at least one ally, the greater hellcat can't be flanked and gains a +2 status bonus to Will saving throws.

Критический провал: Существо становится @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Напугано 4}.

items.name: Наскок

Guardian Guises.name: Guardian Guises
Guardian Guises.descriptionHazard: Apparitions of Aroden in his various 12 guises (the shepherd, soldier, tailor, thief, and more) emerge in pairs to defend this room.
Guardian Guises.disable: @Check[diplomacy|dc:43] (master), @Check[intimidation|dc:43] (master), or @Check[religion|dc:43] (expert); three successes are required to convince the trap that Aroden is truly dead, causing the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.jQdm301h6e8hIY4U]{Spiritual Guardians} to hesitate and protest before fading away

Once per round, if fewer than two spiritual guardians are present, the hazard conjures one new spiritual guardian from one of the statues as an action. items.name: Last Azlanti's Defense
items.description:

One moves to an unoccupied space within the statue's line of effect and makes an attack against an adjacent creature hostile to Kaisentia (spell attack modifier of +33, @Damage[5d8[force]] damage). The other moves to an unoccupied space adjacent to Kaisentia and protects her (90 Hit Points). The hazard rolls initiative.

Haunted Knife Collection.name: Haunted Knife Collection
Haunted Knife Collection.descriptionHazard: Crates of knives and daggers shine with ill intent.
Haunted Knife Collection.disable: @Check[religion|dc:26] (master) to exorcise the spirits, @Check[crafting|dc:33] (expert) to damage the knives, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.9HpwDN4MYQJnW0LG] (5th rank; counteract DC 29) to counteract the crate

items.name: 10,000 Stabs
items.description:
Триггер: A living creature touches one of the crates

Эффект: A cloud of knives rises from the boxes in a 10-foot radius around the touched crate and stabs all creatures in its area, dealing @Damage[10d4[slashing]] damage (@Check[reflex|dc:34|basic] save). The hazard then rolls initiative.

items.description: Fly 15 feet

items.name: Hellfire Regeneration
items.description:
The hellfire hydra has regeneration equal to 5 × the number of heads it has. If a hellfire hydra's body is missing any heads and the remaining stumps haven't been snuffed out, the hydra attempts a @Check[fortitude|dc:42] save after it regains Hit Points from regeneration. On a success, one non-snuffed stump regrows two heads; on a critical success, two nonsnuffed stumps regrow into two heads each. The hellfire hydra can never grow more than 10 heads. The hellfire hydra's regeneration only fully deactivates if all its heads are destroyed and all stumps are snuffed out, at which point it dies.

@Localize[PF2E.NPC.Abilities.Glossary.Regeneration]

items.name: Отращивание головы
items.description:
A hellfire hydra has five heads. A creature can attempt to sever one of the hydra's heads by specifically targeting it and dealing damage equal to the head's Hit Points. A head that isn't completely severed returns to full Hit Points at the end of any creature's turn.

A hellfire hydra can regrow a severed head using hellfire regeneration. A creature can prevent this regrowth by dealing damage to the stump with a cold or water effect, snuffing out its flames. Single-target cold or water effects need to be targeted at a specific stump, but effects that deal splash damage or affect areas covering the hellfire hydra's whole space snuff out all stumps if they deal damage and have the cold or water trait. If the attack that destroys a head deals any damage with the cold or water trait, the stump is snuffed out instantly. If all five heads are snuffed out, the hydra dies.

Hydra Head

  • Иммунитеты: Урон по области
  • Слабости: Cold 15, Holy 10, Water 10

items.description: A hellfire hydra gains an extra reaction per round for each of its heads beyond the first, which it can use only to make Reactive Strikes. It can't use more than 1 reaction on the same triggering action, even if a creature leaves several squares within its reach, and the hydra must use a different head for each Reactive Strike it makes. Whenever one of the hellfire hydra's heads is destroyed, the hydra loses 1 of its extra reactions per round.

items.name: Unholy Heat
items.description: 10 feet, @Damage[9d6[fire]] damage, @Check[reflex|dc:38|basic] save

items.name: Conflagration of Jaws
items.description: The hellfire hydra slams each of its heads into the ground, where they explode before quickly reforming. The hellfire hydra creates a number of @Template[type:burst|distance:5]s within 10 feet equal to its current number of heads. These bursts can't overlap. Each creature in a burst takes @Damage[6d6[fire]|options:area-damage] damage (@Check[reflex|dc:40|basic] save). This counts as a number of attacks equal to the number of heads the hellfire hydra has toward the hydra's multiple attack penalty.

Hellfire Tornado.name: Hellfire Tornado
Hellfire Tornado.descriptionHazard: The very air catches fire from the heat of a dragon's breath, causing a burning tornado.
Hellfire Tornado.disable: The Hellfire tornado can't be disabled—only endured. It ends after 5 rounds.
Hellfire Tornado.reset: Once 5 rounds pass, the Hellfire tornado dissipates and doesn't reset.
Hellfire Tornado.routine:
(1 action; air, fire) The Hellfire tornado—a 15-footdiameter column 80 feet tall—moves 60 feet down the street. It can move through creatures' spaces, and creatures can move into its space, though the tornado's space is difficult terrain. Each creature the tornado moves through or each creature that ends its turn in the tornado's area takes @Damage[(4d10)[bludgeoning],(4d6)[fire]] damage (@Check[reflex|dc:40|basic|traits:air,fire] save). A creature can be affected by the tornado only once per round.

Критический успех: Существо невредимо.

Успех: Существо получает половину урона.

Провал: The creature takes full damage and rises 10 feet into the air as it's engulfed by the tornado ([[/act escape dc=40]]). While engulfed, a creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei] and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1}, and if it doesn't have a fly Speed, it gains a 10-foot fly Speed until it either reaches the ground or ceases to be in the tornado's area, potentially falling when the hazard ends or when it leaves the tornado's area. A creature engulfed by the tornado moves along with it on the tornado's turn.

Критический провал: Как провал, но существо получает двойной урон и поднимается на 20 футов в воздух.

items.description:
40 feet.

A creature that begins its turn within the area feels its body begin to stretch and must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|dc:33] save or become destabilized. A destabilized creature emits a 10-foot destabilizing field aura and becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1}. The destabilization ends when the creature is no longer sickened. A creature that succeeds at its saving throw against the aura is temporarily immune to all destabilizing fields for 1 minute.

items.name: Displace
items.description:

items.name: Перестановка

items.description: The amalgamite chooses up to two destabilized creatures it can see within 50 feet and swaps their positions, or moves one such creature to an unoccupied space it can see within range. If the amalgamite chooses two creatures, it can choose itself as a target, but both targets must be the same size. An unwilling creature can attempt a @Check[will|dc:33] save. If either target succeeds at this saving throw, both are unaffected.

Hellknight Dragoon Squad.description: Some fugitives are so dangerous or numerous that they warrant a whole Hellknight squadron who can ride after quarry and dismount to give chase in crowded settlements. These Hellknights wield flails as capably as they wield fear, using both to subdue and restrain foes.

Bind Them in Chains
items.description:

10 feet.

As long as the dragoon squad has at least 3 segments, all enemy troops within the aura take a –2 circumstance penalty to saves against emotion effects.

items.description: The dragoons draw bows and fire arrows as a ranged attack. When the troop is reduced to 2 or fewer segments, this area decreases to a @Template[type:burst|distance:5].

items.name: Fear the Chain
items.description:
Частота: Раз в раунд

Эффект: The dragoons attempt to [[/act demoralize]] all foes in a @Template[type:emanation|distance:15], comparing the result of a single Intimidation check to each target's Will DC. The squad doesn't take the penalty if they don't speak the same language as a target. It's possible for the dragoon squad to get a different degree of success for each target, and a target is temporarily immune to this ability only if the squad critically fails the check against them.

items.name: Flail Assault
items.description:
Частота: Раз в раунд

Эффект: The dragoons lash out with their flails in a melee attack against each enemy in a @Template[type:emanation|distance:5] (@Check[reflex|dc:25|basic] save). The damage depends on the number of actions.

@Glyph[Action 1] @Damage[(1d8+2)[bludgeoning]|options:area-damage]

@Glyph[Action 2] @Damage[(2d8+9)[bludgeoning]|options:area-damage]

@Glyph[Action 3] @Damage[(3d8+11)[bludgeoning]|options:area-damage]

Hellknight Hunter Squad.name: Hellknight Hunter Squad
Hellknight Hunter Squad.description: Against immense prey, Order of the Pike Hellknights assemble elite squads trained to strike as one, shield each other from fiery breath, protect civilians, and stand strong against foes that would terrify lesser troops.

items.name: Hunters of Monsters
items.description: Hellknight hunters can use Monster Lore to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo] about creatures of any type. Whenever one of the squad's damaging abilities would affect only a single creature that lacks the swarm or troop trait, they gain a +2 status bonus to that ability's Reflex save DC.

items.name: Pin It Down
items.description:
Триггер: An adjacent enemy uses a manipulate or move action, or leaves an adjacent space during a move action it's using

Эффект: The hunters stab with their longspears. The triggering enemy takes @Damage[(4d8+9)[piercing]] damage (@Check[reflex|dc:33|basic] save). If the enemy critically fails this saving throw, the triggering action is disrupted.

items.name: Disciplined Barricade
items.description: The Hellknights defensively lock their shields. Until the start of this troop's next turn, the troop and all allies within a @Template[type:emanation|distance:5] gain a +1 circumstance bonus to their AC and Reflex saving throws.

items.name: Hurl Javelins
items.description: The squad's members throw a volley of javelins. Each creature in a @Template[type:burst|distance:10] within 30 feet of the troop takes @Damage[(5d6+9)[piercing]|options:area-damage] damage with a @Check[reflex|dc:33|basic] save. When the Hellknight hunters are reduced to 2 segments, this area decreases to a @Template[type:burst|distance:5].

items.name: Medic!
items.description: The hunters bandage an adjacent creature. The target regains @Damage[(5d8+20)[healing]] Hit Points, after which the target is immune to this ability for 1 day.

items.name: Phalanx Strike
items.description:
Частота: Раз в раунд

Эффект: The Hellknight hunters strike outward with their longspears in a uniform melee attack against each enemy in a @Template[type:emanation|distance:10] (@Check[reflex|dc:33|basic] save). The damage depends on the number of actions.

@Glyph[Action 1] @Damage[(1d8+5)[piercing]|options:area-damage] damage

@Glyph[Action 2] @Damage[(4d8+9)[piercing]|options:area-damage] damage

@Glyph[Action 3] @Damage[(5d8+13)[piercing]|options:area-damage] damage

items.name: Булава
items.description: С крепкой рукоятью и тяжёлым металлическим навершием, булава прочна и позволяет её владельцу наносить мощные удары и пробивать доспехи.

items.name: Стальной щит
items.description:
Как и деревянные щиты, стальные изготавливаются разных форм и размеров. Хоть и дороже деревянных щитов, но они гораздо более прочные.

items.name: Латный доспех Адских Рыцарей
items.description:
Hellknights wear a variety of armors decorated with designs specific to the order. Hellknight half plate is the armor of choice for Hellknight signifiers, and Hellknight breastplate serves those in the order who lack the training to wear heavy armor.

A character who is a member of the Hellknights has access to these uncommon armors.

items.name: Аура чемпиона
items.description: Вы окружены аурой в 15-футовой эманации. У неё есть признаки @Trait[Aura]{аура} и @Trait[Divine]{сакральный}. Любой последователь вашего божества, находящийся в пределах ауры, сразу же узнаёт, что вы — чемпион своего божества. Эта аура используется в качестве дистанции для вашей "Реакции чемпиона" и для различных других эффектов. Вы можете подавить или восстановить эту ауру одиночным действием (@Glyph[Action 1]) с признаком @Trait[Concentrate]{концентрация}, и она заканчивается если вы @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{Теряете сознание}.

items.name: Exalted Iron Command
items.description:
Триггер: Враг в вашей @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.0x76o5OxgEmvqIDp]{Ауре чемпиона} наносит вам урон

Эффект: You put an impertinent foe who dared harm you in their proper place. You command each enemy in your champion's aura to kneel before you in obedience. If they dare to refuse, they must pay the price in pain and anguish. The enemy must choose one of the following options.

  • Склониться: Враг преклоняет колени, падая @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Ничком} свободным действием (@Glyph[Free]).
  • Отказаться: You deal @Damage[(5d6)[mental],(5)[persistent,mental]] damage to the enemy.

Regardless of which option the enemy chose, your Strikes against it deal 3 extra spirit damage until the end of your next turn.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.2a6fuugiPpICe3Li]

items.name: Оборонительное продвижение
items.description:
With the protection of your shield, you dive into battle! You Raise your Shield and Stride. If you end your movement within melee reach of at least one enemy, you can make a melee Strike against that enemy.

You can use Defensive Advance while Burrowing, Climbing, Flying, or Swimming instead of Striding if you have the corresponding movement type.

items.name: Ужасный удар
items.description:
Требования: Your Strikes currently deal extra damage from your champion's reaction.

Make a Strike against the creature that triggered your champion's reaction. If you hit, double the extra damage the target takes from your reaction, and the target must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|dc:40] save or be @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 1}. Regardless of the result, the creature is temporarily immune to your Gruesome Strike for 24 hours.

Hellknight Sea Brigade.name: Hellknight Sea Brigade
Hellknight Sea Brigade.description:
A Hellknight cavalry brigade consists of several Hellknights and a single field-maralictor, all wearing the distinctive armor of their order and wielding lances. The maralictor speaks for the brigade, questioning travelers the brigade encounters and barking orders. A Hellknight brigade is typically based at a keep or other fortification controlling an area measured by a day's ride in every direction—about 25 miles. Farther-ranging missions are possible but require substantial logistical support.

A military serves to defend and fight on behalf of nations and can be trained and deployed in various ways.

items.name: Защита отряда
items.description:
Пороги: 90 (3 сегмента), 45 (2 сегмента)

@Localize[PF2E.NPC.Abilities.Glossary.TroopDefenses]

items.name: Передвижение отряда
items.description: Когда отряд движется, вы движетесь одним из его сегментов, а остальные сегменты следуют за ним. В конце движения вы можете сгруппировать остальные сегменты, примыкающие к тому, который вы переместили, по своему усмотрению, при условии, что ни один из них не продвинется дальше, чем передвигаемый сегмент. Если вы решили не передвигать отряд на какое-либо расстояние, вы можете изменить положение всех сегментов, пока один остаётся на месте.

items.name: Залп стрел
items.description: The Hellknights draw or reload their longbows, then launch a ranged attack in the form of a volley. This volley is a @Template[type:burst|distance:10] within 100 feet that deals @Damage[(3d8+2)[piercing]|options:area-damage] damage (@Check[reflex|dc:23|basic|options:area-effect] save). items.description:

Эффект: The Hellknights throw a volley of grappling hooks at a 10-foot-radius burst within 30 feet. Five grappling hooks landing at random squares in the burst take hold, and the Hellknights heave, forcibly moving both ships up to 15 feet toward each other until they're adjacent to each other. The ships remain adjacent to each other until all five of the grappling hooks are dislodged (each as an Interact action) or their respective chains are broken (Hardness 8, HP 20, BT 10).

items.name: Морские ноги
items.description: The ship crew ignores the penalty for attacking while on a vehicle that has moved in the last round and takes only a –2 penalty if the vehicle is uncontrolled or used an action with the reckless trait.

items.description: As long as it has 4 segments, the House Thrune elite infantry troop improves its degree of success on rout checks by one step, even when without a commander. When it has three segments, it instead gains a +2 status bonus to rout checks.

items.name: Посох контроля
items.description:
На извилистой вершине золотого посоха выложена целая россыпь ослепительных драгоценных камней. Когда вы владеете этим посохом, вы получаете бонус состояния +1 к проверкам Дипломатии для @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.DCb62iCBrJXy0Ik6]{Просьбы}.

Активация: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.aBQ8ajvEBByv45yz]

  • Чары: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.4gBIw4IDrSfFHik4]
  • 1-й: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.vLA0q0WOK2YPuJs6], @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.aIHY2DArKFweIrpf]
  • 2-й: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.CQb8HtQ1BPeZmu9h], @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.tlSE7Ly8vi1Dgddv]

Требования для создания: Предоставить одно сотворение всех указанных рангов всех перечисленных заклинаний.

items.name: +1 Dottari Robes
items.description: Одежда исследователя достаточно прочна, чтобы ее можно было усилить для защиты, даже учитывая, что это не комплект доспехов. Она бывает разных форм, хотя самые распространенные виды выглядят как облачения жрецов, монашеские одежды или мантии волшебника, поскольку представители всех трех классов обычно избегают ношения доспехов. Авантюристы, которые не носят доспехов, путешествуют в прочной одежде. Хотя это не доспех и использует ваше мастерство защиты без доспехов, всё ещё имеет ограничение на модификатор Ловкости и может давать бонус предмета к КБ, если имеет выгравированные руны мощи.

items.name: Кандалы [Обычные]
items.description:
Вы можете надеть кандалы на кого-то, кто готов или иным образом находится в вашей власти. Надевание кандалов — активность режима исследования занимающая 10–30 секунд, в зависимости от размера существа и количества кандалов, которые вы применяете. Двуногое существо со скованными ногами получает штраф обстоятельства −15 футов к Скоростям, а двурукое существо с закованными запястьями должно преуспеть в @Check[flat|dc:5]{Чистой проверке} каждый раз, когда использует действие @Trait[Manipulate]{воздействия}, иначе это действие проваливается. Этот КС может быть выше, в зависимости от того, как туго кандалы сковывают руки. Существо, прикованное к неподвижному объекту, становится @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Обездвижено}. Для существ с большим или меньшим количеством конечностей, Мастер определяет, имеют ли кандалы вообще какие-то эффекты.

Освобождение существа из обычных кандалов требует 4 успешные проверки @Check[thievery|dc:27|traits:action:pick-a-lock]{Воровства}.

items.name: Hell's Arrest
items.description:
Частота: Раз в раунд

Эффект: Ignaro invokes Hell to wrap in chains a creature within 30 feet of him. He attempts to [[/act grapple skill=arcana]] the target using his Arcana modifier in place of Athletics for the check. If successful, the chains keep the target grappled or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM] for 1 minute, until the target [[/act escape dc=33]]{Escapes}, or until the chains are destroyed (Hardness 10, 30 HP), whichever comes first.

items.name: Hell's Own Servitor
items.description: Ignaro is bound to a phistophilus in Erebus. When Ignaro dies, his body disintegrates and his soul is sent to Hell. All weapons that he wields deal an additional @Damage[1d6[spirit]] damage with the unholy trait.

items.name: Ignite Heresy
items.description: Ignaro declares an object he can see within 30 feet to be heretical. After smoldering for 1 round, it's engulfed in flames, taking @Damage[3d6[persistent,fire]] damage that ignores half of the object's Hardness. Immersion in water for 1 round ends the damage, as does the object being splashed with a flask of holy water. Any other water effect that isn't just mundane water used against the object can attempt to counteract the effect (DC 30). If this ability destroys an object, Ignaro gains temporary Hit Points equal to twice the object's level (minimum 2) that last for 1 minute.

Infernal Bow Shocks.name: Infernal Bow Shocks
Infernal Bow Shocks.descriptionHazard: Wave after wave of Hellish power ripples out from the pentagram surrounding the Inferno Gate, bathing all of the battling armies around it in its dark energies. Some are slain on the spot, while others fall into cracks that open beneath them in the earth, and still others are consumed by ignited gasses.
Infernal Bow Shocks.disable:
@Check[Devil Lore|dc:34] or @Check[HellLore|dc:34] to give the proper incantations and invoke the name of Visperthul to ward off the magical defenses from the Inferno Gate; @Check[arcana|dc:38] (expert), @Check[nature|dc:38] (expert), @Check[occultism|dc:38] (expert), or @Check[religion|dc:38] (expert) to erect a magical barrier to shield against the power emanating from the gate; @Check[survival|dc:43] to use the natural terrain as a shield to survive the onslaught of magical energies; @Check[will|dc:48] save to simply push back against the Hellish storm surge and refute them; or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.9HpwDN4MYQJnW0LG] (9th rank; counteract DC 34) to blast the bow shock with magic to stem its flow; three successes are required to dissipate the hazard's energies.

The first time a PC successfully uses Devil Lore or Hell Lore against this hazard, all PCs gain a +2 status bonus to their saving throws against the hazard's effects.
Infernal Bow Shocks.routine: (2 actions) The infernal bow shocks release a different effect each round for 3 rounds, centered on a randomly-chosen PC each time and never the same PC twice in a row (though creatures standing near each other might just be unlucky). In the first round, it unleashes Flaming Fumes. In the second round, it uses an 8th-rank whispers of the void spell (DC 38), and in the third round, it emulates the effect of an earthquake spell (DC 38), with each of the three piles of tower rubble collapsing as though they were shoddy structures. Notably, no fissures extend into the former inner bailey of Fort Arego (area E4, as outlined by the remaining rectangular battlements). The hazard concludes for the PCs when it's disabled, or when the third round ends.

The hazard unleashes Flaming Fumes on the same target as Shock Wave. A creature must succeed at a Perception check against the hazard's Stealth DC to visually detect the fumes. The infernal bow shocks then roll initiative.

items.name: Flaming Fumes
items.description: A @Template[type:burst|distance:20] of acridsmelling fumes ignites in gouts of hellfire. All creatures in the area take 7d6 fire and @Damage[7d6[spirit]|options:area-damage] damage with a @Check[reflex|dc:38|basic] save.

Infernal Tide.description: Sarglagons can gather to form an infernal tide, a troop that displays unnerving fluidity in the way its devils seem to flow around each other.

items.name: Утопление

Критический провал: Цель падает @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{Без сознания} и начинает задыхаться. Если цель преуспеет в спасброске Стойкости когда задыхается, она откашливает воду и может нормально дышать.
